title: Gravity Well Harness — Antigravity IDE Settings Schema
description: Native Antigravity IDE configuration for Gravity Well Harness (Models, Reasoning Depth, Harness², Local RAG, and Multi-Engine Web Search). API keys are never stored here; they are stored encrypted in ~/.gemini/config/.secrets.vault.enc (AES-256-GCM) or ~/.env.

antigravity.harness.activeModel.description: Active primary model across DeepSeek Official (1M), OpenCode Go Coding Plan, and Antigravity Native.

antigravity.harness.reasoningDepth.description: Reasoning depth & token-efficiency preset (eco = 1024 thinking cap / effort=low; balanced = 2048 cap / effort=high; deep = 8192 cap / effort=max).

antigravity.harness.reasoningEffort.description: Official DeepSeek / OpenCode Go reasoning_effort parameter.

antigravity.harness.deepseek.baseUrl.description: DeepSeek Official API base URL (/chat/completions, /responses, /anthropic, /v1/tools/search). Store DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in ~/.env or AES-256-GCM Secret Vault.

antigravity.harness.opencodeGo.baseUrl.description: OpenCode Go Coding Plan gateway URL. Store OPENCODE_API_KEY in ~/.env or AES-256-GCM Secret Vault.

antigravity.harness.search.defaultEngine.description: Default web search engine or Multi-Engine Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).

antigravity.harness.rag.primaryBackend.description: Primary Local RAG backend for .harness/ collections.

antigravity.harness.harness2.strictSnaps.description: Enforce strict Snapshot Isolation during K-candidate Propose -> Probe -> Compose comparisons.

antigravity.harness.harness2.thinkingBud.description: Maximum thinking token budget per probe turn.

antigravity.harness.swarmRoleModels.description: Per-role subagent model routing across DeepSeek Official and OpenCode Go Coding Plan.
